name: deskorb
description: Desk Orb: pushes live session status (state, context, cost, limits, permission asks, subagents) to an ESP32 round display on your desk

deviceUrl.title: Device URL
deviceUrl.description: Base URL of the Claude Orb display, e.g. http://claude-orb.local or http://192.168.1.50

token.title: Device token
token.description: Shared secret set on the device's settings page; leave empty if none
